title: common_elements
subject:
Assignment name  : common_elements
Expected files   : py_list_intersection_finder.py
Forbidden        : n/a
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Returns a list containing the elements present in every sublist, without duplicates, in ascending order. If the input list is empty, or if any sublist is empty, the result is an empty list. All sublists contain elements of the same comparable type.

Function signature:

  def common_elements(lists: list) -> list:

Examples:

  common_elements([[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], [3, 4, 5]])  ->  [3]
  common_elements([[1, 2], [3, 4]])                   ->  []
  common_elements([])                                 ->  []
